1479-2841-7201-8100.easyPrerequisites:
(optional)You control an Elf or have an Elf card in hand. Your life total is 2 or higher.
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Elven Passage.
1479-2841-7201-8100.description:
Fetch a land using Elven Passage.
When the fetched land enters, Sapling Nursery and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Sapling Nursery trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Sapling Nursery trigger from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Sapling Nursery triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

5166-5759--86.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to cause Screaming Nemesis to take damage.
5166-5759--86.description:
Cause Screaming Nemesis to take damage by any method.
Screaming Nemesis triggers, dealing damage to an opponent.
Guilty Conscience triggers, dealing damage to Screaming Nemesis.
Repeat from step 2.

2557-4772-6441-6664-7942.description:

Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.

1169-3259-7795.notablePrerequisites: At least one opponent cannot block creatures you control.
1169-3259-7795.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached and Drider, triggering Breath of Fury and Drider.
Resolve the Drider trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

864-1987-6747.easyPrerequisites: You control an artifact, creature or land that can enter and tap to produce at least {U}
864-1987-6747.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two artifacts.
864-1987-6747.description:
Activate a mana-producing permanent by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, blinking the mana-producing permanent and Eternal Witness.
When Eternal Witness enters, it triggers, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
864-1987-6747.notes: You must blink a land as your mana-producing permanent to get infinite landfall triggers.

5223-6723-7686.notablePrerequisites: You control four or more Squirrels.
5223-6723-7686.description:
Activate The Unbeatable Squirrel Girl by paying {1}{G}{G}{G}, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token for each Squirrel you control.
Activate four Squirrels by tapping them, adding {1}{G}{G}{G}.
Repeat
5223-6723-7686.notes: You'll create double as many Squirrels each loop. All Squirrels beyond the first four will be untapped and can be used to add additional mana.

2440-6737-6791-7109.description:
Cast Trusty Boomerang by paying {1}.
When Trusty Boomerang enters, Barret's triggers, creating a 2/2 Rebel creature token.
When the Rebel enters, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each Rebel you control.
Activate Trusty Boomerang's equip ability by paying {1}, attaching it to the Rebel token.
Activate the Rebel by paying {1} and tapping it, tapping a creature and returning Trusty Boomerang from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
2440-6737-6791-7109.notes: The cost can be reduced by {1} if you control another Rebel.

1247-3793-5963.description:
Activate Marvin using Apprentice Wizard's ability by paying {U} and tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Marvin using Pili-Pala's ability by paying {2} and untapping it, adding {U}.
Repeat.

1409-5423-5921.description:
Activate Swashbuckler Extraordinaire by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Swashbuckler Extraordinaire enters, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger twice.
Resolve both Deadeye Navigator triggers, repairing it and Swashbuckler Extraordinaire.
Resolve both Swashbuckler Extraordinaire triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate both Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.

2146-3532-5078-6604.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Clinquant Skymage triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Repeat.

4153-4359-6575--136.description:
Activate Terra, Magical Adept by paying {4}{R}{G} and tapping it, exiling it and returning it to the battlefield as Esper Terra.
When Esper Terra enters the battlefield, its first chapter ability triggers, copying another nonlegendary Saga you control and putting two to three lore counters on it.
The Saga tokens first through fourth chapter abilities trigger, as applicable. Resolve all triggers, and sacrifice the Saga token upon resolving the final trigger.
When the Saga token leaves the battlefield, Resourceful Defense triggers, moving the lore counters from the Saga token onto Esper Terra.
Esper Terra's second, third and fourth chapter abilities trigger.
Resolve the second and third chapter abilities.
Resolve the fourth chapter ability, adding {W}{W}{U}{U}{B}{B}{R}{R}{G}{G} and then exiling Esper Terra and returning it to the battlefield as Terra, Magical Adept.
Resourceful Defense and Terra, Magical Adept trigger.
Resolve the Resourceful Defense trigger, moving all counters from Esper Terra onto any other permanent
Resolve the Terra, Magical Adept trigger, causing you to mill five cards and return up to one enchantment card from among them from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
4153-4359-6575--136.notes: The chosen Saga must have no more than four chapter abilities. Once you have infinite white mana, you can instead copy any other permanent besides the chosen Saga, and move counters to and from Esper Terra using Resourceful Defense's ability.

1497-5220-5931-6900.notablePrerequisites:
Funeral Room is unlocked.
Gwenom has attacked this turn.
1497-5220-5931-6900.description:
Activate Wild Cantor by sacrificing it.
When Wild Cantor dies, Mortuary and Funeral Room trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Wild Cantor from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Funeral Room trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Cast Wild Cantor from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

3903-3958-6922.easyPrerequisites: Your deck size is at least 2.
3903-3958-6922.description:
Activate Coveted Falcon by paying {1}{U}, turning it face up.
Coveted Falcon triggers, causing an opponent to gain control of Moderation and causing you to draw a card.
Cast Knowledge Pool by paying {6}.
Whenever the opponent that controls Moderation casts a spell from their hand, Knowledge Pool triggers, exiling that spell.
Because Moderation prevents the opponent from casting more than one spell each turn, the opponent cannot cast the spell permitted by Knowledge Pool, or any other spell that turn.

789-2399-5147--129.easyPrerequisites: Gutter Grime has slime counters on it at least equal to the toughness of the creature card in your hand.
789-2399-5147--129.description:
Cast the creature card in your hand by paying {0}.
Either that creature dies as a state-based action due to having zero toughness, or activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing that creature.
Gutter Grime triggers, putting a slime counter on it and creating a X/X Ooze creature token.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing the Ooze.
When the Ooze dies, Colfenor triggers, returning the creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment abilities, dealing 1 damage each time.
Repeat.
789-2399-5147--129.notes: This combo also puts infinite slime counters on Gutter Grime, allowing you to easily create additional infinitely large creature tokens.

1651-2073-4659-6757--90.description:
Activate Salvaging Station by tapping it, returning the noncreature artifact with mana value 1 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the noncreature artifact enters the battlefield, Weapons Manufacturing triggers, creating a Munitions artifact token.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the noncreature artifact returned in step 1 and the Munitions token, untapping Salvaging Station.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the noncreature artifact.
Repeat.
1651-2073-4659-6757--90.notes: You can sacrifice the Munitions to get infinite damage if desired. If the noncreature artifact chosen can sacrifice itself without tapping or additional costs, you can omit the sacrifice outlet, but will forego the possibility of infinite damage.

1987-4423-4477-5733.notablePrerequisites:
You control a Rogue that does not have summoning sickness and that cannot be blocked by an opponent.

Deal combat damage to an opponent using a Rogue.
Activate Mystic Sanctuary by tapping it, adding {U}.
Cast Notorious Throng by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.

When Greenwarden of Murasa and Mystic Sanctuary enter the battlefield, they trigger.
Resolve the Greenwarden of Murasa trigger, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Mystic Sanctuary trigger, putting Notorious Throng from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Move to your next turn, drawing Notorious Throng during your draw step.
Repeat.

1987-2104-4423-4863.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four Islands.
1987-2104-4423-4863.description:

When Revolutionist and Mystic Sanctuary enter the battlefield, they trigger.
Resolve the Revolutionist trigger, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Mystic Sanctuary trigger, putting Temporal Manipulation from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Move to your next turn, drawing Temporal Manipulation during your draw step.
Repeat.

Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying {E}{E}{E}{E}{E}, sacrificing a creature with mana value 1 or less, and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand, returning Salvager of Secrets from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Salvager of Secrets enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Time Warp from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {1}{B}.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying at most {E}, sacrificing Salvager of Secrets, and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand, returning a creature with mana value 1 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

678-4033-5256.notablePrerequisites: You have a number of cards in hand that is greater than your maximum hand size.
678-4033-5256.description:
Move to your cleanup step.
Discard down to your maximum hand size, ensuring to discard Basking Rootwalla.
Basking Rootwalla is discarded into exile, triggering its madness ability, causing you to pay {0} to cast it from exile.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Basking Rootwalla.
When Basking Rootwalla dies, Enduring Renewal triggers, returning Basking Rootwalla from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing target player to mill cards equal to Basking Rootwalla's power.
Once the stack is empty and all players pass priority, another cleanup step occurs.
Repeat from step 2.

1817-2743-3024.description:
Cast Complete the Circuit by paying {5}{U}, copying the next instant or sorcery spell you cast twice.
Cast Biovisionary by paying {1}{G}{U}.
Holding priority, cast Double Major by paying {G}{U}, targeting Biovisionary.
Complete the Circuit triggers, copying Double Major twice, with both copies targeting Biovisionary.
Resolve all Double Majors, creating three copies of the Biovisionary spells.
Resolve all Biovisionary spells, causing you to have a nontoken Biovisionary and three token Biovisionaries.
At the beginning of your end step, each Biovisionary triggers.
Resolve the first trigger, causing you to win the game.
